protocol.planning_duration: first queued request's independent draw; constant per batch
protocol.execution_duration: four independent component durations per application; parallel execution
protocol.poisson_arrivals: first 200 rate-1/120 arrivals binned into integer slots; complete drainage
protocol.variability: confidence intervals over run means; minima and maxima over individual requests
protocol.finite_input_effect: 200 applications; finite workload averages, not stationary values
